candidates.prompt: An enchanting, hyper-detailed 3D stylized render created in Unreal Engine 5 and Octane Render, set on a tranquil, moonlit desert sand dune at night. In the foreground sits an irresistibly cute, tiny desert jerboa with oversized velvety ears, plush sandy fur, and long kangaroo-like hind legs, balanced on a miniature stool carved from a polished desert rose crystal. With tiny paws, the little jerboa is passionately playing a whimsical miniature grand piano naturally grown from a plump, ribbed barrel cactus. The piano keys are made of smooth, glowing mother-of-pearl shells, and instead of a wooden lid, a giant translucent bioluminescent pink cactus flower blooms open on top, releasing floating musical notes shaped like glowing golden pollen grains into the desert breeze. Rich subsurface scattering on the cactus flesh and glowing flower petals, sparkling individual quartz sand grains, dramatic volumetric moonlight mixed with warm bioluminescent magenta and gold lighting, Pixar-level emotional expression combined with photorealistic material textures, 8k resolution, magical depth of field.
